citations.quote: Skanska's Year-end report 2025 will be released on Friday February 6 at 07:30 am CET.

The report will be presented by Anders Danielsson, Skanska's President and CEO, and Pontus Winqvist, CFO, at a webcasted press- and audio conference at 10:00 am CET at Skanska's head office at Warfvinges väg 25 in Stockholm.
